data.name: Ameyansh
data.gender_notes: Ameyansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ameyansh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ameya’ (which means ‘limitless’ or ‘inexhaustible’) and ‘Ansh’ (which means ‘a part of’ or ‘a manifestation of’). The name signifies a divine being who is the embodiment of limitless blessings or an endless gift from God. The name Ameyansh carries the meaning “God's endless gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ameyansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's endless gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with divine blessings and infinite grace.
data.etymology: Ameyansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's endless gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ameyansh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

It reflects the deep spiritual values and beliefs of the Hindu culture, celebrating the limitless blessings and grace of the divine. Its use in literature and mythology further strengthens the importance and reverence attached to this name.

It serves as a constant reminder of the boundless blessings and support of the divine father, providing emotional strength, courage, and hope.
